engine.description: "auto" (local PP-OCR when its models are downloaded, else Mistral if MISTRAL_API_KEY is set, else models.vision, else text layer), "text-layer", "pp-ocr" (local PP-OCRv5 on onnxruntime-node; downloads 13 MB once), "mistral", or a vision model such as "ollama/gemma4:e4b-it-qat".

pages.description: PDF pages sent to the OCR engine. "auto": all pages for Mistral, scanned pages for local and vision models.

concurrency.description: Parallel page requests (default: the provider's concurrency).

removeHeaderFooter.description: Remove running headers, footers and page numbers that repeat across pages.

minTextChars.description: A PDF page with fewer extractable characters is treated as scanned.

models.description: Models per stage as "provider/model". A stage without a model is skipped.

vision.description: Vision model for scanned pages and images, e.g. "ollama/gemma4:e4b-it-qat".

structure.description: LLM that repairs heading levels. Skipped when unset.

context.description: LLM that writes contextual-retrieval summaries. Skipped when unset.

embedding.description: Embedding model, e.g. "ollama/embeddinggemma". Skipped when unset.

providers.description: Provider settings and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, keyed by the name used in model references.

type.description: Adapter to use. Optional for built-in names (openai, openrouter, anthropic, gemini, ollama, mistral, lmstudio).

baseURL.description: API base URL (proxies, LM Studio, vLLM, self-hosted gateways).

apiKey.description: Programmatic use only. Config files must not contain keys — use environment variables.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the key (default: the provider's standard one).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request.

contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens, for providers that cannot report it.

maxContext.description: Upper bound for Ollama's num_ctx; keeps memory use predictable. Default 32768.

concurrency.description: Maximum parallel requests to this provider.

maxRetries.description: Retries for transient errors (429, 5xx, network). Default 4.

minTokens.description: Smaller chunks are merged with a neighbour in the same section.

overlapTokens.description: Trailing sentences of the previous chunk added for context.

hardBoundaryDepth.description: Headings at this depth or shallower always start a new chunk (2 = H1 and H2).

preserveTables.description: Keep tables in their own chunks (split by rows with the header repeated).

preserveCode.description: Keep code blocks in their own chunks.

tokenizer.description: "o200k" counts real BPE tokens; "estimate" is a fast character-based approximation.

strategy.description: "full" sends the whole document, "hierarchical" sends document + section summaries, "auto" picks by size.

dimensions.description: Output dimensions for models that support it (Gemini, OpenAI text-embedding-3, EmbeddingGemma).

engine.description: Page layout analysis for PDFs with a local ONNX model (block classes + reading order). "auto": on when onnxruntime-node and the downloaded model are present; "pp-doclayout-v3": on, downloading the model (130 MB) on first use; "off": position heuristics only.

render.description: Longer page side, in pixels, of the render the model sees.

extract.description: Cut the figures of PDF pages and images (embedded pictures; with layout analysis also charts and drawings) out as PNG files under figures/ and reference them from the markdown.

describe.description: Have models.vision describe every extracted figure (two to five sentences stored under the image, for retrieval). One vision request per figure.

minSize.description: Smallest figure kept, as a share of the page area; icons and logos fall below it.

engine.description: Local cross-encoder that reorders the top search candidates (eval, mcp). "auto": on when onnxruntime-node and the default model (mmarco-minilm) are present; a model id: on, downloaded on first use (mmarco-minilm 120 MB, 14 languages + transfer; bge-reranker-base 280 MB; bge-reranker-v2-m3 570 MB, 100+ languages, slow on CPU); "off".

candidates.description: First-stage results (hybrid or BM25) handed to the reranker.

enabled.description: Cache OCR pages, summaries and embeddings so reruns are free and resumable.
